description: `interface.inputs` declares all six `type`s: `number` and `boolean` present (CLI `-e` JSON-sniffs `5`/`true`), `integer` absent (its `default: 7` fills in), `string` present as `-e s=1.50` (restored to the exact raw text "1.50", undoing the CLI's own JSON-sniff into the float `1.5`), and `array`/`object` present as JSON-sniffed structured values (`-e arr=[1,2,3]`, `-e obj={"x":1}`). `req` is `required: true` and present -- `c1-interface-inputs-required-missing` is this document's own failure companion, omitting it.
